features.feature_value: Removed when both posts seemed likely to cause controversy on all sides; kept when they wouldn’t ruffle everyone’s feathers.
features.evidence_span: If both posts felt like they were likely to cause controversy on all sides of the spectrum, I was more likely to remove both.
features.rationale: The participant describes a pair-based controversy/impact threshold driving keep/remove decisions.

features.feature_value: Used factual/truthfulness vs conspiracy/gross exaggeration, and removed for name-calling/ad hominem.
features.evidence_span: looking truthful, fact based information versus conspiracy theories and gross exaggerations... looking for name calling and ad hominem.
features.rationale: They specify distinct content criteria for keeping vs removing tied to misinformation and personal attacks.

features.feature_value: Checked whether either post included a call to action of violence or harm.
features.evidence_span: I looked at each post to see if there was any call to action of violence or harm.
features.rationale: Their only stated influence factor is a harm/violence call-to-action cue.

features.feature_value: Focused on whether posts were respectful and contributed to political discussion.
features.evidence_span: I FOCUSED ON WHETHER THE POST WERE RESPECTFUL AND CONTRIBUTED TO POLITICAL DISCUSSION.
features.rationale: They explicitly define a respectful/discussion-contribution criterion for judgments.

features.feature_value: Voted against cursing, name-calling, and language meant to incite the other side.
features.evidence_span: def voted against cursing, name calling, language that would incite the other side
features.rationale: They list specific prohibited rhetorical behaviors that drove removal.

features.feature_value: More offensive/graphic statements—especially with profanity—were more likely to be removed.
features.evidence_span: The more graphic and offensive the statement, especially one containing profanity, the more likely I voted to remove it
features.rationale: They connect profanity/graphic offensiveness directly to removal likelihood and justify it.

features.feature_value: Not fully consistent; later realized some allowed content wasn’t conducive to healthy political dialogue.
features.evidence_span: I'm not sure I was entirely consistent... Some of what I allowed was not conducive to healthy political dialogue.
features.rationale: They describe their internal process changing mid-task and a criterion tied to healthy dialogue.

features.feature_value: Believed both posts should not be deleted because they were freedom of speech without threats.
features.evidence_span: they are both freedom of speech with no threats
features.rationale: Their influence is framed as a threat-free speech principle rather than content quality alone.
